cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Stay Until We’re Okay
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until the relationship feels repaired, even if the practical reason for staying disappears.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Don't call the taxi yet. We're packed, but we haven't settled last night.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I apologised for telling my sister about your debt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Stay a minute. I can't face her checking what I order tonight.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: She's already paid for dinner. We'll be late.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'll be late. Sit with me and help me believe you're coming as my partner, not to report how grateful I am.
